item.title: AI minister seeks new investments through visits to Germany, Saudi Arabia, India
item.description: OTTAWA — Artificial Intelligence Minister Evan Solomon is visiting Saudi Arabia and India after a trip to Germany as part of an effort to drum up new investment in Canadian tech.

item.title: Advocate urges feds to update equity act, settle class action with Black employees
item.description: OTTAWA — An advocate is urging the federal government to update equity legislation for Black employees and to drop its fight against a discrimination lawsuit that has cost more than $15 million so far.

item.title: Federal public servants seek legal advice as they face job cuts
item.description: Several law firms in Ottawa say they're getting an influx of calls from federal workers looking for advice as the public service faces job cuts

item.title: One person injured, dog dead after suspected arson at Windsor, Ont., home
item.description: WINDSOR — One person is injured after police say he jumped out of a second-floor window to escape a fire in Windsor, Ont., that left a dog dead and two other pets missing.

item.title: Quebec auto board lied about cost overruns for online platform, inquiry finds
item.description: QUÉBEC — Quebec's automobile insurance board lied to the provincial government to conceal exploding costs in the creation of the agency's online platform, says a public inquiry into the cost-overrun scandal.

item.title: Ottawa says national security incident, error at emergency stockpile unrelated
item.description: OTTAWA — There was no connection between a national security incident at the country's emergency stockpile warehouse in 2024 and an error that caused the loss of $20-million of medication, according to the Public Health Agency of Canada.

item.title: 3 killed, including suspect, in shooting during Rhode Island youth hockey game
item.description: PAWTUCKET, R.I. (AP) — Three people, including the suspect, were fatally shot during a Rhode Island youth hockey game Monday, authorities said.
